name: io.github.kioie/tiny-go-mcp
title: Tiny Go MCP Server
description: Reference stdio MCP server (add, subtract, greet) for MCP client tests and tinymcp evaluation—not production math or messaging. Use for minimal stdio + demo tools; do not use when you need HTTP/SSE, resources/prompts, or domain integrations (use specialized MCP servers). Alternatives: tinymcp library for thin wrappers, mark3labs/mcp-go for richer APIs/transports, modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk alone for full control.
